title: Like to revive 20 year old game - Kongregrate
author: EvilPugs
selftext:
I like this game and it was fantasy RPG game.  I want to recreate it with AI. I have Claude subscription.  When I tried it for few hours, every image I provided the result was very poorly drawn like in MS paint.  

This game I want to create doesn’t even have any 3d figure, maybe 3d art or 2d art and no animation.   How or what do I use to recreate a game? Can someone help me get started? I don’t want this to be mmorpg type, I want to play solo and enjoy nostalgia.

Help me understand, what model I use and why.  Do I have to switch model during build? Etc etc

replies.body: You're missing everything. Start with a game design document (GDD). Figure out exactly how that game works. Then feed that to Claude.

comments.author: InSilicoAwards
comments.body:
I remade a game from 1993 so I may be in a unique position to help you with this. Before I got started, I did several play sessions, I recorded myself playing it, making verbal notes, transcribed those notes with timestamps with claude code. I looked through the game forums and saw what people complained about and where nostalgia wasn't carrying the game. That's where I started. Then I had it do research on other strategy games in the genre, what's the modern different, what we needed ("I have messages, so I need a message director..."). All of that before I even attempted to reproduce it. Then I looked at different engines and settled on Unreal because I also wanted a project inside of that engine for experience.

Much of it was building workflows to do certain things. It's all sprite based, so I had a mannequin in weapon and various run / idle poses, had chatgpt paint the sprites at different directions in movement. I looked up how Ghosts of Tsushima did grass effects and brought that over. I had to think about light mapping on sprites, so that got implemented. Most of the work was seeing how other people did things and then implementing it. And also refactoring my code every now and then, which is something you should do.

Took about 4-5 weeks of mostly daily work (I'm fortunate I have a significant amount of time currently to devote to these things). Lots of playtesting. I batch major changes into a build. I got to build 36 before I felt it was stable enough to release.

[https://kwe.mdscur.com/](https://kwe.mdscur.com/)

replies.author: EvilPugs
replies.body:
The game is dead, I can’t play it.  I only have few YouTube videos and fandom wiki.

The game I am trying to build has still images, nothing fancy but it still has images of people and monsters.  I want those to be created or picked from wiki or YouTube.  Since this will be sitting on my local only, I think that’s OK or it can alter somewhat I don’t care but a alligator shouldn’t be drawn as big circle with tooth pick lol 

You said you used unreal, is it separate subscription? I only have Claude $20/m subscription.

replies.author: InSilicoAwards
replies.body: Epic's Unreal is free unless you cross a million in gross sales, then they take 5%. It's the engine they used to build Fortnite. There's a ton of free assets in there, animations, etc. And Claude will be able to work within C++ pretty easily. Alternatively, just have Claude build in 3js, which is a browser format and it can iterate quickly. Tell it to look for CC0 assets on huggingface.

comments.author: Verdux_Xudrev
comments.body: It's possible, but I need to hear the name. Also, look into some local gen. I'm getting red-tint fatigue from some of the games here.

comments.author: Catnip_Cartel420
comments.body: check out stability matrix and stable diffusion, if you have a decent gpu, i know it can run on 2080 Super Nvidia. The you can run that image through comfui in the matrix and it can convert it to 3d (that's iffy, same picture ran multiple times gets different results). It can generated all the still images you need in good quality, I saw you ask someone about unreal, it only cost once you have made over 1 million in sales. Unity works as well is a lower bar as it requires 200k in sales before you pay anything. I recommend having claude build a basic chart for the parts of the game so you can work your way through it in a organized fashion. With the 20 a month sub your on, pace yourself so you dont use it all up in one day or you will spend the whole week forgetting things, good luck feel free to reach out if you want help with it.
